description: Get a single Substack user's public profile by handle. Returns profile metadata by default; optional sections include activity, posts, likes-replies, and subscriptions. Supports limiting the number of returned list items.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: Substack username (the part after @ in https://substack.com/@username).

parameters.name: section
parameters.description: Profile section to return. Allowed values: profile (default), activity, posts, likes-replies, subscriptions.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return for list sections (activity, posts, likes-replies, subscriptions). Ignored for section=profile. Range 1-100.
